verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              अधिक्षिप्तस्तु राधेयः शल्येनामिततेजसा । शल्यमाह सुसंक्रुद्धो वाक्शल्यमवधारयन् ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Thus reviled by Shalya of incomparable energy the son of Radha understanding the meaning of the word Shalya by his words said to him in areat anger.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्ण उवाच।
              गुणान् गुणवतां शल्य गुणवान्वेत्ति नागुणः । त्वं तु शल्य गुणैर्हीनः किं ज्ञास्यसि गुणागुणम् ॥२॥
verses.english: Karna said O Shalya, the meritorious only appreciate the merits of those who possess them and not one who has none. You are destitute of all merits. How can you understand what is merit and what is demerit.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुनस्य महास्त्राणि क्रोधं वीर्यं धनुः शरान् । अहं शल्याभिजानामि विक्रमं च महात्मनः ॥३॥
verses.english: O Shalya, I know that powerful weapons of Arjuna, his anger, energy, bow, arrows and as well as the prowess of that high-souled one.

verses.sanskrit: तथा कृष्णस्य माहात्म्यमृषभस्य महीक्षिताम् । यथाऽहं शल्य जानामि न त्वं जानासि तत्तथा ॥४॥
verses.english: O Shalya, you do not know, so well as I do, the greatness of Krishna, the foremost of kings.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेवात्मनो वीर्यमहं वीर्यं च पाण्डवे । जानन्नेवाह्वये युद्धे शल्य गाण्डीवधारिणम् ॥५॥
verses.english: Knowing my own strength as well as that of Pandava I have challenged him in battle, O Shalya, I shall not fall into fire like an insect.

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति वाऽयमिषुः शल्य सुपुङ्खो रक्तभोजनः । एकतूणीशयः पत्री सुधौतः समलङ्कृतः ॥६॥
verses.english: I have this arrow, O Shalya, keen edged, blood-drinking, occupying alone one quiver, furnished with wings, well-steeped in oil and well-adorned.

verses.sanskrit: शेते चन्दनचूर्णेषु पूजितो बहुलाः समाः । आहेयो विषवानुग्रो नराश्वद्विपसंघहा ॥७॥
verses.english: It lies in sandal dust and is being adored by me from a long time. Having the shape and nature of a serpent it is poisonous and dreadful and capable of killing a great many men, horses and elephants.

verses.sanskrit: घोररूपो महारौद्रस्तनुत्रास्थिविदारणः । निर्भिन्द्यां येन रुष्टोऽहमपि मेरुं महागिरिम् ॥८॥
verses.english: Highly dreadful in form it can go through coats of mail and bones. When worked up with anger I can perforate with it even the huge Meru mountain.

verses.sanskrit: तमहं जातु नास्येयमन्यस्मिन् फाल्गुनादृते । कृष्णाद्वा देवकीपुत्रात्सत्यं चापि शृणुष्व मे ॥९॥
verses.english: I will not discharge this arrow at any other person excepting Arjuna or Krishna, the son of Devaki. Listen, I tell you the truth.

verses.sanskrit: तेनाहमिषुणा शल्य वासुदेवधनञ्जयौ । योत्स्ये परमसंक्रुद्धस्तत्कर्म सदृशं मम ॥१०॥
verses.english: Worked up with anger, I shall with that arrow, O Shalya, fight Vasudeva and Dhananjaya. That will be a deed becoming me.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां वृष्णिवीराणां कृष्णे लक्ष्मीः प्रतिष्ठिता । सर्वेषां पाण्डुपुत्राणां जयः पार्थे प्रतिष्ठितः ॥११॥
verses.english: Of all the heroes of the Vrishni race in Krishna only prosperity exists eternally. Of all the sons of Pandu, Partha is the one who comes off invariable victorious.

verses.sanskrit: उभयं तु समासाद्य को निवर्तितुमर्हति । तावेतौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ समेतौ स्यन्दने स्थितौ ॥१२॥
verses.english: Those two foremost of men, seated on the same car, will encounter me single in battle, you will, O Shalya, witness today the nobility of my birth.

verses.sanskrit: मामेकमभिसंयातौ सुजातं पश्य शल्य मे । पितृष्वसा मातुलजौ भ्रातरावपराजितौ ॥१३॥
मणी सूत्र इव प्रोतौ द्रष्टासि निहतौ मया । अर्जुने गाण्डिवं कृष्णे चक्रं तार्क्ष्यकपिध्वजौ ॥१४॥
verses.english: You will seen that (With one shaft) I will kill those two cousins, one of whom is the son of the aunt and the other the son of the maternal uncle-those two invincible warriors. They will took like two pearls strung together in the same string

verses.sanskrit: भीरूणां त्रासजननं शल्य हर्षकरं मम । त्वं तु दुष्प्रकृतिर्मूढो महायुद्धेष्वकोविदः ॥१५॥
verses.english: The Gandiva of Arjuna, the discus of Krishna and their two banners having the emblems of a monkey and Garuda strike terror into the timid. But they are sources of delight to me.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रोतौ एक सूत्रे मणी इव प्रेमसम्बद्धौ ॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: भयावदीर्णः संत्रासादबद्धं बहु भाषसे । संस्तौषि तौ तु केनापि हेतुना त्वं कुदेशज ॥१६॥
verses.english: You are a fool, a bad character and do not know the mode of a true war-fare. Possessed by fear you are giving vent to these ravings.

verses.sanskrit: तौ हत्वा समरे हन्ता त्वामद्य सहबान्धवम् । पापदेशज दुर्बुद्धे क्षुद्र क्षत्रियपांसन ॥१७॥
verses.english: Born in a sinful country you are wicked, mean and a wrath of a Kshatriya or you are praising them for something which is not known to me. Having killed those two first I shall kill you today with all your relatives.

verses.sanskrit: सुहृद्भूत्वा रिपुः किं मां कृष्णाभ्यां भीषयिष्यसि। तौ वा मामद्य हन्तारौ हनिष्ये वापि तावहम् ॥१८॥
verses.english: Being a friend why do you frighten me with (the praises of) those two Krishnas? Either they will kill me today or I will kill them both.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं बिभेमि कृष्णाभ्यां विजानन्नात्मनो बलम् । वासुदेवसहस्रं वा फाल्गुनानां शतानि वा ॥१९॥
verses.english: I know my strength well and I do not fear the two Krishnas. I will kill single handed a thousand Vasudevas and hundreds of Phalgunas. Hold your tongue. O you born in a sinful country.

verses.sanskrit: अहमेको हनिष्यामि जोषमास्स्व कुदेशज । स्त्रियो बालाश्च वृद्धाश्च प्रायः क्रीडागता जनाः ॥२०॥
verses.english: Hear from me, O Shalya, the sayings that have already passed into proverbs, that men young and old and women, persons while sporting utter as if they are their studies about the wicked Madrakas. the Brahmanas also recounted them formerly in the courts of kings. Hearing them, O fool, you may forgive or give a reply.

verses.sanskrit: या गाथाः संप्रगायन्ति कुर्वन्तोऽध्ययनं यथा । ता गाथाः शृणु मे शल्य मद्रकेषु दुरात्मसु ॥२१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: जोषं तूष्णीम् आस्स्व तिष्ठ । क्रीडागताः लीलया आगताः ॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणैः कथिताः पूर्वं यथावद्राजसन्निधौ । श्रुत्वा चैकमना मूढ क्षम वा ब्रूहि चोत्तरम् ॥२२॥
मित्रध्रुङ्मद्रको नित्यं यो नो द्वेष्टि स मद्रकः । मद्रके सङ्गतं नास्ति क्षुद्रवाक्ये नराधमे ॥२३॥
verses.english: Madraka is always a hater of friends. He who hates us is a Madraka. There is no good feeling in a Madraka who is the vilest of men and gives vent to mean words.

verses.sanskrit: दुरात्मा मद्रको नित्यं नित्यमानृतिकोऽनृजुः । यावदन्त्यं हि दौरात्म्यं मद्रकेष्विति नः श्रुतम् ॥२४॥
verses.english: The Madraka is always wicked, untruthful and crooked. We have heard that the Madrakas are wicked till the hour of their death.

verses.sanskrit: पिता पुत्रश्च माता च श्वश्रूश्वशुरमातुलाः । जामाता दुहिता भ्राता नप्ताऽन्ये ते च बान्धवाः ॥२५॥
verses.english: Amongst them the father, the son, the mother, the mother-in-law, the father-in-law, the maternal uncle, the son-in-law, the daughter-in-law, the brother, the grandson, other relations and guests, slaves, male and female mingle together. Thus women freely mix with men, known and unknown, Dishonest as they are they live upon friend and powered corn and fish in their homes and laugh and cry being drunk; they also eat beef. They sing unconnected songs and move about lustfully. They indulge in free speeches amongst themselves. How can virtue find a room among them?
verses.bhavadeepa: अनृतेन चरतीत्यानृतिकः । यावदन्त्यम् अन्त्यजपर्यन्तं मरणावधीति वा ॥२४॥

verses.sanskrit: वयस्याभ्यागताश्चान्ये दासीदासं च सङ्गतम् । पुंभिर्विमिश्रा नार्यश्च ज्ञाताज्ञाताः स्वयेच्छया ॥२६॥
येषां गृहेष्वशिष्टानां सक्तुमत्स्याशिनां तथा । पीत्वा सीधु सगोमांसं क्रन्दन्ति च हसन्ति च ॥२७॥
verses.bhavadeepa: पुंभिः पुरुषैः विमिश्राः संगताः इच्छया मैथुनिनः अज्ञातवत् ज्ञाता अप्यविगीता इत्यर्थः ॥२६॥

verses.sanskrit: गायन्ति चाप्यबद्धानि प्रवर्तन्ते च कामतः । कामप्रलापिनोऽन्योन्यं तेषु धर्मः कथं भवेत् ॥२८॥
मद्रकेष्ववलिप्तेषु प्रख्याता शुभकर्मसु । नापि वैरं न सौहार्दं मद्रकेण समाचरेत् ॥२९॥
मद्रके सङ्गतं नास्ति मद्रको हि सदा मलः । मद्रकेषु च संसृष्टं शौचं गान्धारकेषु च ॥३०॥
verses.english: No one should inake friends with a Madraka or enter into hostilities with him. There is no feeling of friendship in him. The Madraka is always impure.

verses.sanskrit: राजयाजकयाज्ये च नष्टं दत्तं हविर्भवेत् । शूद्रसंस्कारको विप्रो यथा याति पराभवम् ॥३१॥
verses.english: Friendship is lost on a Madraka as purity in Gandharakas and as oblation offered in a sacrifice where the king is both the sacrificer and the priest. As a Brahmana performing the initiation ceremony of a Sudra meets with deterioration as one who hates a Brahmana, meets with deterioration so a person, forming alliance with a Madraka, is deteriorated. As there is no friendship in a Madraka, so is your poison is powerless, O Scorpion; with this Mantra of Atharvan I have duly performed the ceremony of peace.
verses.bhavadeepa: मद्रकेषु संसृष्टं नष्टम् एवं गान्धारकेषु शौचं नष्टं भवेत् ॥३०॥

verses.sanskrit: यथा ब्रह्मद्विषो नित्यं गच्छन्तीह पराभवम् । यथैव सङ्गतं कृत्वा नरः पतति मद्रकैः ॥३२॥
verses.bhavadeepa: राजा याजको यस्य तस्मिन्याज्ये हविर्नष्टं भवेत् ॥३१॥

verses.sanskrit: मद्रके सङ्गतं नास्ति हतं वृश्चिक ते विषम् । आथर्वणेन मन्त्रेण यथा शान्तिः कृता मया ॥३३॥
verses.bhavadeepa: यथैवेति । यथा मद्रकैः सङ्गतं कृत्वा पतति यथा वा मद्रके सङ्गतं नास्ति हे वृश्चिक तथा ते विषं हतमित्युत्तरेण सम्बन्धः । यद्येतत्सत्यं तर्हि तव विषं नश्यत्विति मन्त्रेण सर्वथा विषं नश्यतीत्यर्थः ॥३२॥

verses.sanskrit: इति वृश्चिकद‌ष्टस्य विषवेगहतस्य च । कुर्वन्ति भेषजं प्राज्ञाः सत्यं तच्चापि दृश्यते ॥३४॥
verses.english: It is seen that with these words the wise treat a person bitten by a scorpion and affected by its poison.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विद्वञ्जोषमास्स्व शृणु चात्रोत्तरं वचः । वासांस्युत्सृज्य नृत्यन्ति स्त्रियो या मद्यमोहिताः ॥३५॥
verses.english: Thinking of this, O learned one, either hold your tongue or hear something more that I will say. (The Madraka) women, influenced by liquor, throw off their robes and dance; they do not observe control in intercourse and do whatever they like. Being the son of one of those women, how can you, O Madraka, dictate duties unto a man?

verses.sanskrit: मैथुनेऽसंयताश्चापि यथाकामवराश्च ताः । तासां पुत्रः कथं धर्मं मद्रको वक्तुमर्हति ॥३६॥
यास्तिष्ठन्त्यः प्रमेहन्ति यथैवोष्ट्रदशेरकाः । तासां विभ्रष्टधर्माणां निर्लज्जानां ततस्ततः ॥३७॥
verses.english: Being the son of one of those women who live and answer calls of nature like camels and asses, sinful and shameless as they are, how can you wish to dictate the duties of men?
verses.bhavadeepa: यथाकामं वरयन्ति ताः असंयता इति च्छेदः । तासां पुत्रः सङ्करजात इत्यर्थः ॥३६॥

verses.sanskrit: त्वं पुत्रस्तादृशीनां हि धर्मं वक्तुमिहेच्छसि । सुवीरकं याच्यमाना मद्रिका कर्षति स्फिचौ ॥३८॥
अदातुकामा वचनमिदं वदति दारुणम् । ’मा मां सुवीरकं कश्चिद्याचतां दयितं मम ॥३९॥
verses.english: When a Madraka woman is requested to give a little bit of vinegar she scratches her hips and reluctant to give it gives vent to harsh words-“Let no one ask of me vinegar which is so dear to me. I would give him my son, I would give him my husband but I would not part with my vinegar.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रं दद्यां पतिं दद्यां न तु दद्यां सुवीरकम्’ । गौर्यो बृहत्यो निर्ह्रीका मद्रिकाः कम्बलावृताः ॥४०॥
घस्मरा नष्टशौचाश्च प्राय इत्यनुशुश्रुम । एवमादि मयाऽन्यैर्वा शक्यं वक्तुं भवेद्बहु ॥४१॥
verses.english: The Madraka maidens, I am informed, are generally shameless, have profuse hairs, are gluttonous and impure.

verses.sanskrit: आकेशाग्रान्नखाग्राच्च वक्तव्येषु कुकर्मसु । मद्रकाः सिन्धुसौवीराः धर्मं विद्युः कथं त्विह ॥४२॥
verses.english: These and such like many other things of their evil acts beginning with the tip of their hair to that of their nails I can recount.

verses.sanskrit: पापदेशोद्भवा म्लेच्छा धर्माणामविचक्षणाः । एष मुख्यतमो धर्मः क्षत्रियस्येति नः श्रुतम् ॥४३॥
verses.english: The Madrakas and Sindhu Souviras are born in a sinful country, are Melechas and innocent of duties. How can they know them?

verses.sanskrit: यदाजौ निहतः शेते सद्भिः समभिपूजितः । आयुधानां सांपराये यन्मुच्येयमहं ततः ॥४४॥
verses.english: We have heard that this is the prime duty of the Kshatriyas that when slain in battle he would lie down on earth being spoken highly of by the pious.

verses.sanskrit: ममैष प्रथमः कल्पो निधने स्वर्गमिच्छतः । सोयं प्रियः सखा चास्मि धार्तराष्ट्रस्य धीमतः ॥४५॥
verses.english: This is my first resolution, desirous of heaven after my death as I am that I will lay down my life in this clash of arms.
verses.bhavadeepa: सांपराये समूहे संग्रामे इत्यर्थः । मुच्येयं जीवितमिति शेषः ॥४४॥

verses.sanskrit: तदर्थे हि मम प्राणा यच्च मे विद्यते वसु । व्यक्तं त्वमप्युपहितः पाण्डवैः पापदेशज ॥४६॥
verses.english: I am the dear friend of the intelligent son of Dhritarashtra. For him are my vital airs and the wealth that I possess. As for you, born as you are in a sinful country it is clear that you have been bribed by the Pandavas as because you behave towards us in everything like an enemy.

verses.sanskrit: यथा चामित्रवत्सर्वं त्वमस्मासु प्रवर्तसे । कामं न खलु शक्योऽहं त्वद्विधानां शतैरपि ॥४७॥
संग्रामाद्विमुखः कर्तुं धर्मज्ञ इव नास्तिकैः । सारङ्ग इव घर्मार्तः कामं विलप शुष्य च ॥४८॥
verses.english: As a pious man is not to be easily pursuaded by atheists so I am not to be dissuaded from this battle by hundreds of persons like you.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं भीषयितुं शक्यः क्षत्रवृत्ते व्यवस्थितः । तनुत्यजां नृसिंहानामाहवेष्वनिवर्तिनाम् ॥४९॥
verses.english: Like a deer perspiring, you may either bewail or pant; observant of the duties of a Kshatriya I am incapable of being frightened by you.

verses.sanskrit: या गतिर्गुरुणा प्रोक्ता पुरा रामेण तां स्मरे । तेषां त्राणार्थमुद्यन्तं वधार्थं द्विषतामपि ॥५०॥
verses.english: I remember the end, described to me formerly by my preceptor Rama, which befell those foremost of men who laid down their lives and did not return from the field of battle.

verses.sanskrit: विद्धि मामास्थितं वृत्तं पौरूरवसमुत्तमम् । न तद्भूतं प्रपश्यामि त्रिषु लोकेषु मद्रप ॥५१॥
verses.english: I am bent upon rescuing the Kauravas and killing my enemies; know that I am determined upon imitating the excellent conduct of Pururavas.

verses.sanskrit: यो मामस्माद‌भिप्रायाद्वारयेदिति मे मतिः। एवं विद्वञ्जोषमास्स्व त्रासात्किं बहु भाषसे ॥५२॥
verses.english: I do not, O king of Madraka, see a man in the three worlds who can shake this resolution of mine.

verses.sanskrit: न त्वां हत्वा प्रदास्यामि क्रव्याद्भ्यो मद्रकाधम । मित्रप्रतीक्षया शल्य धृतराष्ट्रस्य चोभयोः ॥५३॥
verses.english: Do not speak more. Knowing this Why do you rove in such a way from fear? O wretch of a Madraka, I shall not kill you now and offer your dead body to the carnivorous animals,

verses.sanskrit: अपवादतितिक्षाभिस्त्रिभिरेतैर्हि जीवसि । पुनश्चेदीदृशं वाक्यं मद्रराज वदिष्यसि ॥५४॥
verses.english: Out of regard for a friend, O Shalya, for the sake of Dhritarashtra's son and for avoiding blame-for these three reasons, you will live.
verses.bhavadeepa: हत्वा अर्जुनेन घातयित्वा । मित्रप्रतीक्षया मित्रकार्यावेक्षणेन चात् दुर्योधनस्य तयोरेवोभयोः ॥५३॥

verses.sanskrit: शिरस्ते पातयिष्यामि गदया वज्रकल्पया । श्रोतारस्त्विदमद्येह द्रष्टारो वा कुदेशज ॥५५॥
verses.english: O king of Madras, if you speak again in this strain I will crush down your head with my mace, as hard as the thunder.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णं वा जघ्नतुः कृष्णौ कर्णो वा निजघान तौ । एवमुक्त्वा तु राधेयः पुनरेव विशांपते । अब्रवीन्मद्रराजानं याहि याहीत्यसंभ्रमम् ॥५६॥
verses.english: O you born in a sinful country, people will either see or hear today that either the two Krishnas have slain Karna or Karna has killed the two Krishnas."
